Name: Reverse Transmute
Author: Daenvil
Description:
Ever found yourself short on copper and had to go back to boring mining? [b]This mod simply adds iridium -> gold -> iron -> copper transmute recipes[/b], expanding on the already existing transmute mechanic.

The conversion is just 1:1 (1 bar for 1 bar) to avoid abusing the mechanic. Copper and iron are unlocked at the same level as their vanilla counterparts (Mining 4 for iron->copper and Mining 7 for gold->iron), while iridium -> gold is unlocked at Mining 9.
